Portuguese-Caripuna wordlist (ca. 500 items, collected 24 Jan 1927 from Vicente Bocamuller) written with Portuguese-style graphic accents (Mapú, Haná, Çumá, Náme, Pôihí). The editors' general note IV (p. 12, PDF p. 12) says only that accent marks on vowels in some vocabularies 'corresponde aos sons fortes e longos de sílabas tônicas' — an orthographic convention for the whole Glossário, not a stress rule.
